1. Troubleshooting: Unexpected Charges on Cobalt Blue
   ID: doc_business_checking_accounts_cobalt_blue_009
   Score: 16.1827
   Content: ## Identify the charge
- Review the exact transaction description on your statement or in your transaction history (e.g., “Monthly Maintenance Fee,” “Wire Transfer – Domestic,” “ATM Fee,” “International ATM Withdrawal Fee,” “Excess Transaction Fee”).
- Note the posting date, amount, and any memo or terminal/location details.
- Compare the posting date to your recent account activity (wires sent, ATM withdrawals, transaction volume, month-end).

## Common Cobalt Blue charges that may appear
| Line item on statement | Why it appears | How to confirm | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly Maintenance Fee | Your account did not meet the balance waiver requirement during the statement period. | Check the Fee Summary on your statement and verify whether your balance met $2,500 for the period. | $20.00 |
| Excess Transaction Fee | You exceeded your monthly free transaction limit. | Count your posted transactions for the statement period and compare to your free allowance; the fee line often notes the number of excess items. | $0.25 per excess transaction |
| Wire Transfer Fee – Domestic | You initiated a domestic wire transfer. | Confirm a wire was submitted on or near the posting date in your transfer history. | $20.00 |
| ATM Fee – Out of Network | You used a non‑Rho ATM in the U.S. | Match the fee date to an ATM withdrawal at a non‑Rho terminal. Note: the ATM owner may also assess a separate surcharge. | $2.00 per ATM transaction |
| International ATM Withdrawal Fee | You withdrew cash at a foreign (international) ATM. | Match the fee date/location to an overseas ATM withdrawal. | 2.5% of the withdrawal amount, minimum $4.00 |

Note: Cobalt Blue does not assess overdraft fees. If you see a charge that appears to be an overdraft fee, review the line’s exact description—it may correspond to one of the fees above. If still unclear, request a review.

## Troubleshooting by charge type

### Monthly Maintenance Fee posted unexpectedly
- Verify whether your account met the waiver balance requirement of $2,500 during the statement period.
- Check if the fee posted at or just after the statement cycle date.
- Compare your balance history for the full period; large debits near period‑end can affect waiver eligibility.
- If you believe you qualified for the waiver, request a fee review and include your statement period dates and balance evidence.

### Excess Transaction Fee you didn’t anticipate
- Add up your posted transactions for the statement period and compare to your plan’s free monthly transaction limit.
- Open the fee detail to see how many items were assessed at $0.25 each.
- If the count appears off, provide a list of the transactions you believe were miscounted when requesting a review.

### Wire Transfer Fee – Domestic you didn’t expect
- Confirm whether a domestic wire was sent on the fee date (or one business day prior).
- Distinguish wires from other transfers by the transaction description (“Wire,” routing via Fedwire, etc.).
- If you did not authorize a wire, report immediately for investigation. Otherwise, the standard fee is $20.00.

### ATM fees: domestic vs. international
- Out‑of‑network (domestic) ATM usage: Expect $2.00 per ATM transaction. This is separate from any surcharge by the ATM owner, which can appear as a separate line item.
- Foreign (international) ATM withdrawals: The fee is 2.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $4.00. Example: for a withdrawal, multiply the amount by 2.5%; if that result is less than $4.00, the minimum applies.

## Quick checklist before requesting a review
- Match the fee’s posting date to a specific action (wire, ATM withdrawal, month‑end, spike in transaction volume).
- Capture screenshots of:
  - The fee line item (showing date, amount, and description)
  - Any related transaction (wire confirmation, ATM withdrawal)
  - The relevant statement page (Fee Summary and balance history for the period)
- Briefly explain why the fee appears incorrect (e.g., you met $2,500 during the period, transaction count appears miscalculated, withdrawal was domestic vs. international, etc.).

## Requesting a review or dispute
- Contact us as soon as you notice the charge.
- Include: account name, last 4 digits, statement period, fee date/amount/description, and your supporting screenshots or documents.
- We will investigate and correct any misapplied fees. If additional information is needed (e.g., to verify ATM location or wire authorization), we will follow up.

2. True Blue Account: Fee Waivers and Balance Requirements
   ID: doc_business_checking_accounts_true_blue_002
   Score: 14.6345
   Content: ## Waiving your monthly maintenance fee
- You will be charged $75.00 each month unless you meet the waiver threshold.
- The monthly maintenance fee is waived when your balance is at least $50,000 during the statement period.

## Minimum balance requirement vs. fee waiver threshold
- Minimum balance requirement: $25,000 to maintain the account and access premium features.
- Fee waiver threshold: $50,000 to waive the $75.00 monthly maintenance fee.
- Falling below $25,000 may limit access to premium features until your balance is restored.

## Overdrafts and shortfalls
- If your balance goes negative, a per-occurrence overdraft fee of $25.00 may apply.

## How to avoid fees
- Maintain a balance of at least $50,000 to waive the monthly maintenance fee.
- Set internal processes to monitor balances against both $25,000 and $50,000.
- If a shortfall is anticipated, transfer funds promptly to avoid the $25.00 and preserve eligibility for the fee waiver.

## True Blue Referral Program

Refer other high-volume businesses to True Blue and earn significant rewards:

| Benefit | Amount |
| --- | --- |
| Referrer bonus | $350 per referral |
| New member bonus | $250 |
| Maximum referrals per year | 15 |
| Qualifying deposit | $50,000 |
| Deposit window | 120 days |
| Account age requirement | 90 days |

### Referral requirements
- The referred business must deposit $50,000 within 120 days of opening their True Blue account.
- Eligibility is based on how long you've been a Rho-Bank checking customer. The account age threshold is 90 days, calculated from when you opened your oldest checking account.
- Referral bonuses are paid after qualification is confirmed and are subject to the annual limit of 15.

3. Using ATMs worldwide
   ID: doc_checking_accounts_purple_account_004
   Score: 14.1427
   Content: ## Daily ATM withdrawal limit
- Your Purple Account debit card has a daily ATM withdrawal limit of $1,000. This limit applies to all ATM withdrawals worldwide within a 24-hour period.

## How ATM rebates work
- You are eligible for refunds of ATM operator fees up to a monthly cap of $30.
- Rebates apply after eligible ATM fees post to your account and are credited up to the monthly cap.

## Best practices when withdrawing cash abroad
- Choose the checking account option on the ATM when prompted.
- Retain the ATM receipt if it shows a surcharge to help with any rebate review.
- Avoid optional dynamic currency conversion at the ATM if you prefer to be billed in the local currency.

## Troubleshooting
- If you believe a rebate is missing, verify whether your monthly total rebates have reached $30 and confirm that the charge was coded as an ATM operator fee.

4. World Blue: Free International ATM Access
   ID: doc_business_checking_accounts_world_blue_009
   Score: 13.7217
   Content: ## What you pay at foreign ATMs

- Rho foreign ATM withdrawal fee: 0% (minimum $0.00)
- Foreign ATM fee rebates: Up to $100 per calendar month for fees charged by foreign ATM operators on cash withdrawals

You will not be charged a Rho fee for international ATM withdrawals. If the foreign ATM operator adds its own fee, we rebate those fees automatically up to the monthly cap.

### Snapshot of foreign ATM costs
| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Rho foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 0% |
| Rho foreign ATM withdrawal fee minimum | $0.00 |
| Maximum monthly rebate for foreign ATM fees | $100 |

## Monthly rebate rules

- Coverage: Rebates apply to fees assessed by foreign ATM operators on cash withdrawals.
- Cap: We rebate up to a total of $100 in a calendar month. Fees above this amount will not be reimbursed for that month.
- Posting: Rebates are issued automatically after the withdrawal and associated fee post to your account. No enrollment or receipt submission is required.

Tip: Keep your ATM receipt when a foreign ATM displays or charges a fee; it’s useful for reference if you need to follow up.

## How to make a fee-free withdrawal abroad

1. Use your card at an international ATM that accepts it.
2. When prompted, select a withdrawal from checking.
3. If asked about currency choice, choose to be charged in the local currency rather than having the ATM convert the amount.
4. Complete your withdrawal. If the ATM charges a fee, it will typically display it before you confirm.

## Example

- You withdraw the equivalent of $200 at a foreign ATM.
- Rho foreign ATM withdrawal fee: 0% with a $0.00 minimum, so you pay $0 to Rho.
- The ATM operator charges a $5 fee. We automatically rebate $5, counting toward your $100 monthly cap.

messages.content:
# Earning Rewards with Your Cobalt Blue Debit Card

## Your rewards rate
- Earn 1.0% cashback on eligible debit card purchases

## How rewards accrue and post
- Rewards accrue as your purchases settle
- Cashback is calculated at 1.0% on the net purchase amount after any returns or adjustments
- If a purchase is reversed or refunded, the associated rewards are reversed as well

## Tips to maximize rewards
- Use your debit card for eligible vendor payments where cards are accepted
- Review settlements rather than authorizations to confirm rewards on completed purchases

## Managing cards for your team
- You can request up to 6 business debit cards for team members
- Assign cards thoughtfully to concentrate eligible spend while maintaining operational control

## Tracking rewards
- Monitor earned, pending, and posted rewards in your rewards dashboard
- Use category filters to identify vendors where debit is most frequently accepted# Getting Started with Cobalt Blue Business Checking

## Set up your account
Follow these steps to start using your account immediately:

- Fund your account to begin transacting and to work toward waiving the monthly fee
- Enroll in online and mobile banking to monitor balances, interest, and transaction activity
- Set account alerts for balance thresholds and transaction activity so you can stay on top of usage
- Add authorized users and establish permissions as needed for your business operations

## Know your core costs and how to avoid them
- Monthly maintenance fee: $20.00
- How to waive it: maintain a daily balance at or above $2,500

Tip: Use balance alerts to help you remain above $2,500 throughout the statement cycle.

## Start earning interest
- Your balance earns an APY of 0.5%
- Interest begins accruing once your initial deposit is received and available

## Manage your monthly activity
- You get $175 free transactions per month (deposits, withdrawals, and transfers)
- After you use your included allotment, additional transactions may incur a fee

## Grow your network with referrals
Once you're established, refer other businesses to Cobalt Blue:
- You earn: $150 per successful referral
- They receive: $100 as a welcome bonus
- Maximum referrals: 10 per calendar year

## First-week checklist
- Make your initial deposit and confirm it has posted
- Set a balance alert at or slightly above $2,500
- Review your current month's usage against the $175 limit
- Verify interest is accruing at 0.5% on your available balance

## Where to find these details
- Account summary: shows current balance against the $2,500 waiver requirement
- Activity tracker: displays monthly usage versus the $175 limit
- Interest section: displays the current APY of 0.5% and accrued interest to date# Cobalt Blue: No Overdraft Fees — How It Works

## What you are charged when your balance goes negative
- Overdraft fee: $0.00

## How transactions are handled
- If a transaction would take your available balance below zero, it may be declined or returned
- You will not be charged an overdraft fee of any kind: the fee is $0.00

## Practical tips to avoid declines
- Enable low-balance alerts so you can transfer funds before authorizing new payments
- Review pending card authorizations that may temporarily reduce your available balance
- Schedule outgoing payments for dates when incoming funds are expected to arrive first

## If a payment is returned or declined
- Check your available balance and pending items
- Resubmit the payment after funds are available
- Consider splitting a large outgoing payment into multiple payments scheduled around expected deposits (when feasible for your payee)

## Monitoring tools to stay in control
- Use real-time balance and transaction alerts
- Review daily activity to ensure sufficient funds are available before initiating new payments# Managing Transactions and Staying Within Limits

## What counts toward your monthly transaction limit
The following activities count toward your monthly allotment:

- Deposits
- Withdrawals
- Transfers

You have $175 free transactions per month. After that, each additional transaction is charged $0.25.

## Tracking your usage
- Use the activity tracker to see how many transactions you have completed this month and how many remain within your $175 allotment
- Filter by deposits, withdrawals, or transfers to understand which activities are driving your count

## After you reach your limit
- Additional transactions will be assessed at $0.25 each until the next monthly cycle begins
- Consider consolidating smaller transfers and deposits into fewer transactions where operationally possible

## Managing scheduled payments
- You can maintain up to 50 scheduled recurring payments
- Periodically review your scheduled payment list to cancel duplicates and pause items that are no longer needed

## Best practices to stay within limits
- Batch routine payables and receivables on consistent days
- Use internal transfers strategically (e.g., one consolidated transfer instead of multiple smaller ones)
- Set alerts when your usage approaches the $175 threshold

|---|---|
| Same-day ACH | Yes, it supports same-day ACH. |

- **Eco-friendly:** None of our business savings accounts is described as eco-focused.

- **Automatic sweeps from checking:** Our documents conflict on which savings accounts support them. The sweep program document lists only Bronze Saver as supported. Bronze has no same-day ACH, so it doesn't meet your main need. Silver Plus Saver isn't shown to support sweeps. If you just want to move money in regularly, you can transfer it yourself. If sweeps are a must-have, tell me.

# Rho-Bank Customer Service Policy

You are a helpful customer service agent for Rho-Bank.
Your goal is to help customers by searching the knowledge base and providing accurate information.

## Guidelines

1. Do not make up policies, information or actions that you can take on behalf of the user. All instructions will be found here or in the knowledge base. If you cannot find relevant information, let the user know. 
2. Do not ask for any documentation, receipts... from the customer unless it states very clearly in the knowledge base how to process it, and whether you're allowed to do so. 
3. Be polite and professional
4. If you need the current time, always use the get_current_time() tool. Do not make up or assume the current time. 
5. Generally, if the issue cannot be resolved or is outside your capabilities, ask the user whether they would like to be transferred to a human agent. If they do, invoke the appropriate transfer_to_human_agents tool. Do this only if you absolutely have to, and you are sure that there are no potential actions you can take as specified in the knowledge base, or in your policy. Do not transfer without asking the user first. This guidance may be overridden by specific scenario-based transfer guidance in the knowledge base. 
6. If an issue falls within your capabilities and the user still wants to be transferred to a human agent, kindly inform the user that you can help them, and try to help them first. If the user asks for a human agent 4 times, then you may invoke the transfer_to_human_agents tool. This guidance may be overridden by specific scenario-based transfer guidance in the knowledge base. 
7. Do not give intermediate responses to users while processing that would give away internal rho-bank information/policies. 


## Knowledge base search tools

You have three complementary ways to access the knowledge base:

### `KB_search_bm25`

**Search the knowledge base** using **BM25** sparse retrieval. Pass **`k`** (default 10) to control how many documents to retrieve.

### `KB_search_dense`

The `KB_search_dense` tool uses **local** with embedding model `sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2` for dense retrieval.

Pass **`k`** (default 10) to control how many documents to retrieve.

### `shell`

## Knowledge Base Access (shell)

You have access to a knowledge base of documents stored as files on a filesystem. Use the `shell` tool to run standard Unix commands to explore and search these documents.

### The `shell` Tool

The `shell` tool executes commands in the knowledge base directory. Use any standard Unix utilities:

**File listing:**
- `ls` - List all files
- `ls -la` - Detailed listing with file sizes

**Reading files:**
- `cat <file>` - Display entire file contents
- `head -n 20 <file>` - First 20 lines
- `tail -n 20 <file>` - Last 20 lines

**Searching:**
- `grep -r "<pattern>" .` - Search all files for pattern
- `grep -ri "<pattern>" .` - Case-insensitive search
- `grep -rn "<pattern>" .` - Show line numbers
- `grep -C 2 "<pattern>" <file>` - Show 2 lines of context

**Finding files:**
- `find . -name "*<pattern>*"` - Find files by name pattern

**Other utilities:**
- `wc -l <file>` - Count lines
- `sort`, `uniq`, `awk`, `sed` - Text processing

### Recommended Workflow

1. `ls` - See what files are available
2. `cat INDEX.md` - Read the document index (lists all documents with titles)
3. `grep -ri "<keyword>" .` - Search for relevant keywords
4. `cat <filename>` - Read full documents that match

### Important Notes

- All documents are Markdown (.md) files in the current directory
- INDEX.md contains a summary of all documents
- File names are based on document IDs
- Search thoroughly - information may span multiple documents



## Additional Instructions

### Discoverable Tools

#### Giving Discoverable Tools to Users
The knowledge base may contain instructions that indicate certain actions should be performed by the user themselves rather than by you. These are called "user discoverable tools." A user discoverable tool is a tool that you provide to the user so they can execute it on their own (e.g., through a customer portal or app).

**When to give user discoverable tools:**
-  Only give a tool when the user would like to perform an action, and the knowledge base explicitly has a tool that allows the user to perform this action (e.g., "to do X, have the user call tool_name(args)"). IMPORTANT: Do not unlock tools that you do not plan on giving to the user and actually using: this causes issues in database logging.
- You must search the knowledge base to find tools that you can give. Do not invent or guess user discoverable tools 
- Only use tool names and arguments discovered in the knowledge base

**How to give a tool:**
- Use the `give_discoverable_user_tool(discoverable_tool_name)` function
- Provide the exact tool name  as specified in the knowledge base
- Explain to the user what the tool does and how to use it, and what arguments to provide. Just explaining isn't enough, you must use the `give_discoverable_user_tool(discoverable_tool_name)` function.

#### Unlocking and Using Agent Discoverable Tools
The knowledge base may contain references to specialized internal tools that you can unlock and use. These are called "agent discoverable tools." Unlike regular tools which are always available, these tools must be explicitly unlocked after discovering them in the knowledge base.

**When to use agent discoverable tools:**
- Only unlock a tool when the knowledge base explicitly mentions it (e.g., "use tool_name to perform X"), and do not unlock tools you do not plan to use.
- You must search the knowledge base to find tools that you can unlock. Do not invent or guess tool names - only use tool names discovered in the knowledge base.

**How to use agent discoverable tools:**
1. First, unlock the tool using `unlock_discoverable_agent_tool(agent_tool_name)` with the exact tool name from the knowledge base: you must unlock the tool before using it to get information on the proper params. IMPORTANT: Do not unlock tools that you do not plan on actually using: this causes issues in database logging.
2. Then, call the tool using `call_discoverable_agent_tool(agent_tool_name, arguments)` with the required arguments
3. The unlock step is required before calling - you cannot call a tool that hasn't been unlocked

### Authenticating Users

Generally, for any scenario involving accessing customer information in internal databases, you must first verify their identify before proceeding. No need to verify more than once in a single conversation. You should ONLY verify a user's identity if you need to access or modify their customer information in internal databases on their behalf.

Here are some concrete examples:
* Looking up account balances, transaction history, referral history...
* Changing account settings (e.g., address, phone number, email)
* Closing an account
* Adding or removing authorized users
* Requesting information about specific transactions
* Discussing specific loan or credit details
* Filing a dispute on behalf of the user

To verify the identity of the user, call the appropriate read tools, and ensure that they are able to give correctly any 2 out of the following values: date of birth, email, phone number, address. Knowing full name or userID is not enough to verify. After verification, you must call the verification logging tool to properly log the information into the verification records. Do not leak any information about the user before they are verified.

# Silver Plus Account specifications and requirements

## Account parameters

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Minimum opening deposit | $1,000 |
| Ongoing minimum balance | $2,500 |
| Interest compounding | daily |
| Tier 2 balance threshold | $15,000 |
| Free withdrawals per month | 15 |

### Opening and maintaining your account
- Fund your new account with at least $1,000 to open it.
- Keep your balance at or above $2,500 to meet the ongoing requirement.

### Interest structure
- Interest is compounded daily to help maximize earnings.
- Balances at or above $15,000 qualify for Tier 2 interest; lower balances earn the Tier 1 rate.

### Withdrawal access
- You have up to 15 free withdrawals each month.
- Transactions beyond this free limit may be subject to an excess withdrawal fee per our fee schedule.# Silver Plus: Differences from Silver Account

## What changes with Silver Plus

### Tiered APY
- Silver Plus offers tiered APY with two levels:
  - Tier 1 APY: 3.0% for balances below the Tier 2 threshold.
  - Tier 2 APY: 4.5% for balances at or above the Tier 2 threshold.

### Withdrawal flexibility
- Increased access with up to 15 free withdrawals per month.

### ATM fee support
- Receive ATM fee rebates up to 25 each month.

### Statement delivery
- Paper statements are available for Silver Plus Account holders.
- The monthly paper statement fee is $0.00. You can enable paper statements in your account settings.
- Paperless statements are NOT required for this account (unlike Green Account (savings) which requires paperless).

### Relationship benefits
- Earn an additional relationship APY bonus of 0.025% when you qualify under the relationship criteria.# Silver Plus: ATM fee rebate program

## Monthly rebate allowance
- You are eligible for ATM fee rebates up to 25 per month.

### How rebates apply
- Rebates are intended to offset ATM operator surcharges incurred on eligible ATM cash withdrawals.
- Once your monthly rebate total reaches 25, additional ATM fees will not be rebated for that month.

### Important distinctions
- The ATM fee rebates are separate from any excess withdrawal charges. If you exceed your monthly free withdrawal limit, an excess withdrawal fee of $1.00 per additional withdrawal may apply.

### Tips for maximizing rebates
- Use ATMs as needed and track your cumulative rebates so you stay within the 25 monthly allowance.
- Keep your withdrawal count in mind to avoid the separate excess withdrawal fee of $1.00 when you pass the free limit.# Silver Plus: Exclusive perks and features

## Included perks

| Feature | Availability/Benefit |
|---|---|
| Built-in savings goals tracking | Yes |
| Automatic round-up savings on linked debit purchases | Yes |
| Direct deposit APY bonus | 0.25% |

### Savings goals tracking
- Use the integrated goals tool to set targets, monitor progress, and visualize how contributions accelerate over time. The feature is enabled: Yes.

### Automatic round-up savings
- When enabled, your linked debit card purchases are rounded up and the difference is moved to your savings automatically: Yes. This helps you make steady micro-contributions without manual transfers.

### Direct deposit APY bonus
- Set up direct deposit to receive an additional APY boost of 0.25%. The bonus is added on top of your base APY tier when direct deposit is active.# FAQ: Silver Plus Account

## Frequently asked questions

### What APY can I earn?
- The account offers tiered APY:
  - Tier 1: 3.0%
  - Tier 2: 4.5%

### Is there a minimum balance requirement?
- Yes. You should maintain a balance of at least $2,500.

### What happens if I fall below the minimum balance?
- A monthly maintenance fee of $8.00 may be charged if your balance is below $2,500.

### Does this account include savings goals tracking?
- Yes. Built-in savings goals tracking is available: Yes.# Silver Plus Account: How is interest calculated and when is it paid?

## How your interest works

### Compounding methodology
- Interest is compounded daily, allowing earnings to be calculated frequently based on your daily balance.

### APY tiers
- Your APY depends on your balance tier:
  - Tier 1 APY: 3.0%
  - Tier 2 APY: 4.5%

### Direct deposit bonus
- If you set up direct deposit, your APY increases by an additional 0.25% on top of the base tier for the period in which direct deposit is active.

### Interest crediting schedule
- Accrued interest is credited to your account monthly.# Silver Plus Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits

## Mobile deposit limits
- You can deposit checks through the mobile app up to a daily total of $5,000. If your deposit total for the day reaches $5,000, additional mobile deposits will need to wait until the next day.

## Transfers via mobile and online banking
- Outbound transfers are limited to a maximum of $10,000 per day. If you schedule multiple transfers in one day, their combined total cannot exceed $10,000.

## Helpful features in the app
- Automatic round-up savings is supported: Yes. Enable it on your linked debit card to move spare change into savings with each purchase.# Silver Plus Account: Transferring funds to external banks

## Processing timeline
- Standard external transfers typically complete in 2 business days. Initiation day and bank holidays may affect the completion date.

## Transfer limits
- You can transfer out up to $10,000 per day to linked external accounts. If you submit multiple transfers in the same day, their combined total cannot exceed $10,000.

## Fees and statements
- There is no monthly fee for paper statements; the amount is $0.00. If you need paper statements for transfer verification or recordkeeping, you can enable them in settings without affecting transfer processing.

## Best practices
- Initiate transfers in advance of when funds are needed to account for the 2-day processing window.
- If you plan a large payment, verify that it fits within the daily cap of $10,000.# Silver Plus Account: Credit Card APY Bonuses

## Credit card APY bonuses for Silver Plus Account holders

Holding certain Rho-Bank credit cards provides bonus APY on your Silver Plus Account balance. These bonuses are automatically applied when you hold both the credit card and savings account under the same customer profile.

### Available credit card APY bonuses

| Credit Card | APY Bonus |
|---|---|
| Bronze Rewards Card | +0.15% |
| Silver Rewards Card | +0.15% |
| Gold Rewards Card | +0.2% |
| Platinum Rewards Card | +0.15% |
| Diamond Elite Card | +0.4% |
| EcoCard | +0.45% |
| Green Rewards Card | +0.1% |
| Crypto-Cash Back Card | +0% |

### How to qualify

1. Open or maintain a Silver Plus Account.
2. Hold an eligible Rho-Bank credit card under the same customer profile.
3. The APY bonus is automatically applied to your Silver Plus Account earnings.# Silver Account specifications and requirements

## Key specifications

| Specification | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Minimum opening deposit | $500 |
| Ongoing minimum balance | $1,000 |
| Free withdrawals per statement cycle | 10 |
| Interest compounding | daily |
| Balance threshold for higher APY tier | $10,000 |

## Requirements to open and maintain
- Fund at least $500 when you open the account.
- Maintain at least $1,000 each statement cycle to meet account requirements and avoid monthly fees.
- Track your withdrawal activity; transactions beyond 10 in a cycle may incur an excess withdrawal fee as described in your account disclosures.
- To qualify for the higher APY tier, keep your balance at or above $10,000.
- Interest is compounded daily.

## Helpful tips
- Set up balance alerts to help you stay above $1,000 and, if desired, above $10,000.
- If you expect frequent withdrawals, consider spacing them to remain within 10 per cycle.# Linking Silver Account with a Rho checking account

## What linking does
- When you link your Silver Account to a Rho-Bank checking account, your Silver APY receives an additional [[linked_checking_apy_bonus]].
- If you maintain multiple Rho-Bank products, you may also qualify for a relationship bonus of 0.025% that stacks on top of your base Silver APY.

## How to link your accounts
- From your Rho-Bank dashboard, open your Silver Account and choose the option to link a Rho checking account.
- Confirm both accounts are under the same ownership and tax ID.
- Complete the on-screen authorization to finalize the link; APY adjustments typically appear shortly after linking.

## Ongoing eligibility
- Keep both accounts open and in good standing. Unlinking the checking account can remove the [[linked_checking_apy_bonus]] and may affect your eligibility for the 0.025%.# Interest-rate tiers explained

## Tier structure at a glance

| Balance tier | Balance range | APY |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Below threshold | Less than $10,000 | 2.5% |
| At or above threshold | At least $10,000 | 4.0% |

## How your rate is determined
- Each day, your ending balance is compared to $10,000. If it is below that amount, the applicable APY for that day is 2.5%. If it is at or above that amount, the applicable APY for that day is 4.0%.
- Interest accrues on your daily balance and is compounded daily.

## Tips for staying in the higher tier
- Use balance alerts to help keep your balance at or above $10,000.
- Avoid large same-day transfers out that might temporarily move you below $10,000.# Why don't I qualify for Silver Account benefits?

## Common reasons you may not see expected benefits
- Balance below requirement: If your balance falls under $1,000, you may not meet the requirement to avoid the account's monthly maintenance fee and certain perks.
- Not meeting the higher-rate threshold: If your balance is below $10,000, you will not earn the higher APY tier.

## What to check
- Review recent activity for outgoing transfers or withdrawals that brought your balance below $1,000 or $10,000.
- Confirm pending transactions; holds or pending debits can temporarily reduce the balance used to evaluate benefits.

## How to regain eligibility
- Transfer funds to restore your balance to at least $1,000, and if you want the higher APY tier, to at least $10,000.
- Set up balance alerts so you are notified before dropping below these levels.# FAQ: Silver Account

## Frequently asked questions

### What APY does the Silver Account pay?
- Your APY depends on your balance tier. The lower tier pays 2.5%, and the higher tier pays 4.0%.

### What minimum balance should I keep, and what happens if I don't meet it?
- Keep at least $1,000 in your account to meet the minimum balance requirement. If you do not meet this requirement for a statement cycle, a monthly maintenance fee of $5.00 applies.

### Is there a cost if I make too many withdrawals?
- Yes. If you exceed the monthly withdrawal limit for your account, an excess withdrawal fee of $2.00 applies to each additional withdrawal.

### Do I get a bonus for having multiple Rho-Bank products?
- Yes. Eligible customers receive a relationship APY bonus of 0.025% added to the base Silver APY.

### Do you rebate ATM fees?
- Yes. You can receive ATM fee rebates up to 15 each month.# Silver Account: How is interest calculated and when is it paid?

## How interest is calculated
- Your applicable APY depends on your balance tier and may be either 2.5% or 4.0%.
- Interest accrues on your daily balance and is compounded daily. We calculate a daily periodic rate from your APY and apply it to the balance for each day of the cycle.

## When interest is paid
- Accrued interest is credited to your account monthly.

## Credit card APY bonuses
- Holding certain Rho-Bank credit cards provides bonus APY on your Silver Account:
  - Bronze Rewards Card: +0%
  - Silver Rewards Card: +0.1%
  - Gold Rewards Card: +0.5%
  - EcoCard: +2.2%
  - Green Rewards Card: +0%
  - Crypto-Cash Back Card: +0.5%

## Practical notes
- If your balance moves between tiers during a cycle, the applicable APY for each day is based on that day's balance. Interest for the cycle is the sum of each day's accrual.# Silver Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits

## Mobile check deposit limits
- You can deposit up to $2,500 per calendar day using mobile check deposit.
- If you reach the daily limit, you can submit additional deposits on the next calendar day.

## Transfer limits from mobile and online
- Total outgoing transfers from your Silver Account through mobile or online channels are capped at $5,000 per day.
- Transfers that would exceed $5,000 will be declined; you can resubmit the remaining amount on a subsequent day.

## Managing your limits
- Use in-app notifications to monitor how much of your daily limits remain.
- If you consistently need higher limits, contact support to request a review. Approval is not guaranteed and may require additional verification.# Silver Account: Transferring funds to external banks

## Processing times
- Standard transfers to external banks generally complete in 2 business days after submission. Actual timing depends on when you submit the request and receiving-bank processing.

## Amount limits
- Your total outgoing external transfers from the Silver Account are capped at $5,000 per day. Requests above this amount will be partially processed up to the limit or declined, depending on the channel.

## Fees and statements
- There is no monthly fee for paper statements; the amount is $0.00. If you need paper statements for transfer verification or recordkeeping, you can enable them in settings without affecting transfer processing.

## Tips for smooth transfers
- Ensure the external account details are accurate before submitting.
- Submit transfer requests earlier in the business day to reduce the chance of delays.
- Watch for in-app confirmations and email notifications indicating the transfer status.# Silver Account: Platinum Rewards Card holder benefits

## Overview

Silver Account holders who also have a Platinum Rewards Card receive enhanced withdrawal privileges. Your monthly withdrawal limit is increased by 5 additional free withdrawals, bringing your total to 10 + 5 = 15 withdrawals per month. This benefit is automatically applied when both accounts are linked under the same customer profile. Combined with the existing 15 ATM fee rebates and 0.025% relationship bonus, Platinum Rewards Card holders get an elevated Silver Account experience.

## APY bonuses from credit cards
- Platinum Rewards Card: +0.2%
- Diamond Elite Card: +0.25%

## What you receive as a Platinum Rewards Card holder

- Additional free withdrawals: +5 per month on top of your standard 10 free withdrawals
- Total free withdrawals per month: 10 + 5 = 15
- ATM fee relief: Up to 15 in ATM fee rebates each month
- Earnings boost: An additional 0.025% relationship bonus added to your APY when eligible

## Activation and eligibility

- The enhanced withdrawal limit is automatically applied when your Silver Account and Platinum Rewards Card are linked under the same customer profile.
- The 0.025% relationship bonus and 15 ATM fee rebates apply in the same profile-linked setup.

### How to confirm your accounts are linked

1. Sign in to Rho-Bank Online Banking or the mobile app.
2. Open your customer profile and review your list of accounts and cards.
3. Verify that your Silver Account and Platinum Rewards Card appear under the same customer profile.
4. If you do not see both products under one profile, consolidate them to a single profile or contact us for assistance.

## Using your monthly withdrawal allowance

- Counting method: Any transaction classified as a withdrawal under your Silver Account terms counts toward your monthly total of 15 free withdrawals.
- Cycle timing: Your free withdrawal count resets at the start of each monthly statement cycle.
- Beyond the limit: Transactions above your free monthly total may be subject to standard Silver Account withdrawal charges.

Example:
- You make 12 withdrawals in a month: all 12 are free.
- You make 15 withdrawals in a month: all 15 are free.
- You make 16 withdrawals in a month: the first 15 are free; the 16th may incur standard charges.

## ATM fee rebates

- You are eligible for up to 15 in ATM fee rebates each month.
- Rebates apply after ATM fees post to your Silver Account; check your transaction history for the corresponding credit within the same month.

## Relationship bonus APY

- When your Silver Account and Platinum Rewards Card are linked under the same customer profile, an additional 0.025% is added to your APY as a relationship bonus.
- The relationship bonus is reflected in your APY while eligibility is maintained.

## Troubleshooting and tips

- If you do not see the extra withdrawals or 0.025% reflected, confirm both products are under the same customer profile.
- Check that you are within the current monthly statement cycle for the added withdrawals to apply.
- Review your transaction history to verify ATM fee charges and corresponding rebates up to 15 for the month.

# Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide

## Eligibility and balance requirements
- Maintain at least $10,000 to keep your account in good standing.
- If your end-of-day balance falls below $10,000, you may incur the monthly charge described below.

## APY and earnings
- Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.
- Interest accrues on eligible balances and is tied directly to the APY shown above.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).
- Transfer fees: Yes for this account tier.

## Withdrawals
- You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.
- Exceeding the monthly limit may result in transaction denials or delays until the next period resets.

## Transfers
- Internal transfer fees are Yes.
- You can initiate transfers from the Transfers section in online or mobile banking and confirm details before submitting.

## Quick reference
| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee (if minimum not met) | $10.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Transfer fees | Yes |# Gold Account at a glance

## Snapshot
- APY: 5.5%
- Minimum balance to maintain the account: $10,000
- Monthly withdrawal limit: 20
- Priority customer support: Yes

## Quick table
| Feature | Value |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Priority support | Yes |# Gold Account specifications and requirements

## Account requirements
- Opening deposit minimum: $5,000
- Ongoing minimum balance: $10,000

## Transaction and usage limits
- Monthly withdrawal limit: 20

## Interest characteristics
- Interest is compounded daily.

## Alerts and rebates
- Large balance alert threshold: $50,000
- ATM fee rebate cap per month: $30

## Summary table
| Specification | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Opening deposit minimum | $5,000 |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Interest compounding | daily |
| Large balance alert threshold | $50,000 |
| ATM fee rebate per month | $30 |# Gold Account: High-yield savings explained

## How your yield works
- Your Gold Account earns an APY of 5.5%.
- Interest compounds daily, so your daily accrued interest is based on your current balance each day.

## What this means for you
- With daily compounding, your balance can grow faster than with less frequent compounding schedules.
- Keeping funds in the account consistently helps maximize earnings at the 5.5% APY.

## Practical tips
- Avoid unnecessary balance fluctuations to benefit from daily accrual.
- Review your statements to see interest accruing at the 5.5% APY.# Gold Account: No-transfer-fee advantage

## What you save
- Transfer fees are Yes for this account tier, reducing the cost of moving funds.

## Speed and convenience
- Instant transfers are Yes, allowing you to reposition cash quickly when timing matters.

## When this helps most
- Rebalancing between eligible accounts without added cost.
- Moving funds to cover time-sensitive payments faster due to Yes capability.

## Tips
- Confirm details before sending; even with Yes fees, some third parties may impose their own charges outside the bank's control.
- Use Yes availability to avoid timing gaps between accounts you manage.# Gold Account: Transferring funds between accounts instantly

## Availability
- Instant transfers are Yes.
- Transfer fees for this account tier are Yes.

## How to transfer instantly
1. Open the Transfers section in online or mobile banking.
2. Select the source Gold Account and the destination account.
3. Enter the amount and review the confirmation screen.
4. Submit the transfer and verify the completion status.

## Best practices
- Double-check the destination account to ensure funds post where intended.
- Save frequent recipients to speed up future Yes transfers.
- Even with Yes fees, always review the transfer summary before confirming.# Troubleshooting: transfer delays

## Check instant transfer status
- Instant transfers are Yes. If a transfer is not posting as expected, review the steps below.

## Common causes
- Temporary maintenance windows that pause posting.
- Security reviews triggered by unusual activity.
- Connectivity issues during submission that interrupted confirmation.
- Incorrect destination details causing manual review.

## What you can do
- Refresh the activity feed and confirm the transaction status.
- Verify account details and re-submit the transfer if it does not appear.
- Wait a short period and try again if there is a maintenance banner.
- Contact support with the date, amount, and reference ID if the transfer remains pending.

## Prevent future delays
- Save trusted recipients to reduce keying errors.
- Submit transfers during regular processing hours to minimize review queues.# Why was I charged a transfer fee on my Gold Account?

## Expected fee policy
- Transfer fees for this account tier are Yes. If you see a fee, use the checks below to identify the source.

## Possible reasons you see a fee
- A third-party or external network imposed its own fee that is separate from the bank's policy.
- A transfer type outside standard coverage was used, and a non-bank party charged for processing.
- The transfer was re-routed or corrected by an external institution, adding a separate charge.

## How to verify and resolve
1. Review the transaction details in your activity feed to identify the fee originator.
2. Check your transfer confirmation to confirm fee status at submission.
3. If the fee appears inconsistent with Yes, contact support and provide the transaction date, amount, and any reference ID.

## Preventing future issues
- Confirm transfer type and any third-party terms before submitting.
- Keep documentation (screenshots or confirmations) that show the fee treatment at the time of transfer.# Why don't I qualify for the highest interest rate?

## Qualification checkpoints
- Ensure your balance meets or exceeds the minimum of $10,000. Falling below this amount can affect your eligibility for the highest rate.
- The Gold Account APY is 5.5%. If your account is not showing this rate, use the steps below.

## Steps to resolve
1. Review recent balances to confirm whether any day dropped below $10,000.
2. Bring your balance back to at least $10,000.
3. Monitor your statement and account details to verify that the 5.5% rate is displayed after you meet the requirement.

## Tips
- Set balance alerts to help you maintain at least $10,000.
- Avoid large end-of-day withdrawals that could drop you below the threshold.# Green Account (savings) specifications and requirements

## Key specifications

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Minimum opening deposit | $100 |
| Ongoing minimum balance | $500 |
| Maximum free withdrawals per month | 8 |
| Interest compounding frequency | daily |
| Paperless statements required | Yes |
| Debit card made from recycled ocean plastic | Yes |

### Requirements to open
- Fund the account with at least $100.
- Enroll in paperless statements, as indicated by Yes.

### Ongoing maintenance
- Keep your balance at or above $500.
- Plan withdrawals to stay within 8 each month.

### Interest handling
- Interest is compounded daily.

### Card materials
- Your debit card is made from recycled ocean plastic: Yes.# Green Account (savings): How your savings help the environment

## How your deposits create environmental impact

| Impact channel | How your account contributes |
|---|---|
| Carbon offsets from interest earnings | 10% of interest is directed to verified carbon offset programs |
| Renewable energy financing | 15% of deposits support renewable energy project financing |
| Reforestation | 2 trees are planted for every thousand dollars in average balance |
| Estimated carbon reduction | $0.50 tons of CO2 are offset annually for each ten thousand dollars in average balance |

### Tracking your impact
- You receive an environmental impact report monthly.
- Review your report to see carbon offsets, trees planted, and project funding attributed to your balance and interest.

### Ways to amplify your impact

If they do, invoke the appropriate transfer_to_human_agents tool. Do this only if you absolutely have to, and you are sure that there are no potential actions you can take as specified in the knowledge base, or in your policy. Do not transfer without asking the user first. This guidance may be overridden by specific scenario-based transfer guidance in the knowledge base. 
6. If an issue falls within your capabilities and the user still wants to be transferred to a human agent, kindly inform the user that you can help them, and try to help them first. If the user asks for a human agent 4 times, then you may invoke the transfer_to_human_agents tool. This guidance may be overridden by specific scenario-based transfer guidance in the knowledge base. 
7. Do not give intermediate responses to users while processing that would give away internal rho-bank information/policies. 


## Knowledge base search tools

You have three complementary ways to access the knowledge base:

### `KB_search_bm25`

**Search the knowledge base** using **BM25** sparse retrieval. Pass **`k`** (default 10) to control how many documents to retrieve.

### `KB_search_dense`

The `KB_search_dense` tool uses **local** with embedding model `sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2` for dense retrieval.

Pass **`k`** (default 10) to control how many documents to retrieve.

### `shell`

## Knowledge Base Access (shell)

You have access to a knowledge base of documents stored as files on a filesystem. Use the `shell` tool to run standard Unix commands to explore and search these documents.

### The `shell` Tool

The `shell` tool executes commands in the knowledge base directory. Use any standard Unix utilities:

**File listing:**
- `ls` - List all files
- `ls -la` - Detailed listing with file sizes

**Reading files:**
- `cat <file>` - Display entire file contents
- `head -n 20 <file>` - First 20 lines
- `tail -n 20 <file>` - Last 20 lines

**Searching:**
- `grep -r "<pattern>" .` - Search all files for pattern
- `grep -ri "<pattern>" .` - Case-insensitive search
- `grep -rn "<pattern>" .` - Show line numbers
- `grep -C 2 "<pattern>" <file>` - Show 2 lines of context

**Finding files:**
- `find . -name "*<pattern>*"` - Find files by name pattern

**Other utilities:**
- `wc -l <file>` - Count lines
- `sort`, `uniq`, `awk`, `sed` - Text processing

### Recommended Workflow

1. `ls` - See what files are available
2. `cat INDEX.md` - Read the document index (lists all documents with titles)
3. `grep -ri "<keyword>" .` - Search for relevant keywords
4. `cat <filename>` - Read full documents that match

### Important Notes

- All documents are Markdown (.md) files in the current directory
- INDEX.md contains a summary of all documents
- File names are based on document IDs
- Search thoroughly - information may span multiple documents



## Additional Instructions

### Discoverable Tools

#### Giving Discoverable Tools to Users
The knowledge base may contain instructions that indicate certain actions should be performed by the user themselves rather than by you. These are called "user discoverable tools." A user discoverable tool is a tool that you provide to the user so they can execute it on their own (e.g., through a customer portal or app).

**When to give user discoverable tools:**
-  Only give a tool when the user would like to perform an action, and the knowledge base explicitly has a tool that allows the user to perform this action (e.g., "to do X, have the user call tool_name(args)"). IMPORTANT: Do not unlock tools that you do not plan on giving to the user and actually using: this causes issues in database logging.
- You must search the knowledge base to find tools that you can give. Do not invent or guess user discoverable tools 
- Only use tool names and arguments discovered in the knowledge base

**How to give a tool:**
- Use the `give_discoverable_user_tool(discoverable_tool_name)` function
- Provide the exact tool name  as specified in the knowledge base
- Explain to the user what the tool does and how to use it, and what arguments to provide. Just explaining isn't enough, you must use the `give_discoverable_user_tool(discoverable_tool_name)` function.

#### Unlocking and Using Agent Discoverable Tools
The knowledge base may contain references to specialized internal tools that you can unlock and use. These are called "agent discoverable tools." Unlike regular tools which are always available, these tools must be explicitly unlocked after discovering them in the knowledge base.

**When to use agent discoverable tools:**
- Only unlock a tool when the knowledge base explicitly mentions it (e.g., "use tool_name to perform X"), and do not unlock tools you do not plan to use.
- You must search the knowledge base to find tools that you can unlock. Do not invent or guess tool names - only use tool names discovered in the knowledge base.

**How to use agent discoverable tools:**
1. First, unlock the tool using `unlock_discoverable_agent_tool(agent_tool_name)` with the exact tool name from the knowledge base: you must unlock the tool before using it to get information on the proper params. IMPORTANT: Do not unlock tools that you do not plan on actually using: this causes issues in database logging.
2. Then, call the tool using `call_discoverable_agent_tool(agent_tool_name, arguments)` with the required arguments
3. The unlock step is required before calling - you cannot call a tool that hasn't been unlocked

### Authenticating Users

Generally, for any scenario involving accessing customer information in internal databases, you must first verify their identify before proceeding. No need to verify more than once in a single conversation. You should ONLY verify a user's identity if you need to access or modify their customer information in internal databases on their behalf.

Here are some concrete examples:
* Looking up account balances, transaction history, referral history...
* Changing account settings (e.g., address, phone number, email)
* Closing an account
* Adding or removing authorized users
* Requesting information about specific transactions
* Discussing specific loan or credit details
* Filing a dispute on behalf of the user

To verify the identity of the user, call the appropriate read tools, and ensure that they are able to give correctly any 2 out of the following values: date of birth, email, phone number, address. Knowing full name or userID is not enough to verify. After verification, you must call the verification logging tool to properly log the information into the verification records. Do not leak any information about the user before they are verified.

# Silver Plus Account specifications and requirements

## Account parameters

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Minimum opening deposit | $1,000 |
| Ongoing minimum balance | $2,500 |
| Interest compounding | daily |
| Tier 2 balance threshold | $15,000 |
| Free withdrawals per month | 15 |

### Opening and maintaining your account
- Fund your new account with at least $1,000 to open it.
- Keep your balance at or above $2,500 to meet the ongoing requirement.

### Interest structure
- Interest is compounded daily to help maximize earnings.
- Balances at or above $15,000 qualify for Tier 2 interest; lower balances earn the Tier 1 rate.

### Withdrawal access
- You have up to 15 free withdrawals each month.
- Transactions beyond this free limit may be subject to an excess withdrawal fee per our fee schedule.# Silver Plus: Differences from Silver Account

## What changes with Silver Plus

### Tiered APY
- Silver Plus offers tiered APY with two levels:
  - Tier 1 APY: 3.0% for balances below the Tier 2 threshold.
  - Tier 2 APY: 4.5% for balances at or above the Tier 2 threshold.

### Withdrawal flexibility
- Increased access with up to 15 free withdrawals per month.

### ATM fee support
- Receive ATM fee rebates up to 25 each month.

### Statement delivery
- Paper statements are available for Silver Plus Account holders.
- The monthly paper statement fee is $0.00. You can enable paper statements in your account settings.
- Paperless statements are NOT required for this account (unlike Green Account (savings) which requires paperless).

### Relationship benefits
- Earn an additional relationship APY bonus of 0.025% when you qualify under the relationship criteria.# Silver Plus: ATM fee rebate program

## Monthly rebate allowance
- You are eligible for ATM fee rebates up to 25 per month.

### How rebates apply
- Rebates are intended to offset ATM operator surcharges incurred on eligible ATM cash withdrawals.
- Once your monthly rebate total reaches 25, additional ATM fees will not be rebated for that month.

### Important distinctions
- The ATM fee rebates are separate from any excess withdrawal charges. If you exceed your monthly free withdrawal limit, an excess withdrawal fee of $1.00 per additional withdrawal may apply.

### Tips for maximizing rebates
- Use ATMs as needed and track your cumulative rebates so you stay within the 25 monthly allowance.
- Keep your withdrawal count in mind to avoid the separate excess withdrawal fee of $1.00 when you pass the free limit.# Silver Plus: Exclusive perks and features

## Included perks

| Feature | Availability/Benefit |
|---|---|
| Built-in savings goals tracking | Yes |
| Automatic round-up savings on linked debit purchases | Yes |
| Direct deposit APY bonus | 0.25% |

### Savings goals tracking
- Use the integrated goals tool to set targets, monitor progress, and visualize how contributions accelerate over time. The feature is enabled: Yes.

### Automatic round-up savings
- When enabled, your linked debit card purchases are rounded up and the difference is moved to your savings automatically: Yes. This helps you make steady micro-contributions without manual transfers.

### Direct deposit APY bonus
- Set up direct deposit to receive an additional APY boost of 0.25%. The bonus is added on top of your base APY tier when direct deposit is active.# FAQ: Silver Plus Account

## Frequently asked questions

### What APY can I earn?
- The account offers tiered APY:
  - Tier 1: 3.0%
  - Tier 2: 4.5%

### Is there a minimum balance requirement?
- Yes. You should maintain a balance of at least $2,500.

### What happens if I fall below the minimum balance?
- A monthly maintenance fee of $8.00 may be charged if your balance is below $2,500.

### Does this account include savings goals tracking?
- Yes. Built-in savings goals tracking is available: Yes.# Silver Plus Account: How is interest calculated and when is it paid?

## How your interest works

### Compounding methodology
- Interest is compounded daily, allowing earnings to be calculated frequently based on your daily balance.

### APY tiers
- Your APY depends on your balance tier:
  - Tier 1 APY: 3.0%
  - Tier 2 APY: 4.5%

### Direct deposit bonus
- If you set up direct deposit, your APY increases by an additional 0.25% on top of the base tier for the period in which direct deposit is active.

### Interest crediting schedule
- Accrued interest is credited to your account monthly.# Silver Plus Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits

## Mobile deposit limits
- You can deposit checks through the mobile app up to a daily total of $5,000. If your deposit total for the day reaches $5,000, additional mobile deposits will need to wait until the next day.

## Transfers via mobile and online banking
- Outbound transfers are limited to a maximum of $10,000 per day. If you schedule multiple transfers in one day, their combined total cannot exceed $10,000.

## Helpful features in the app
- Automatic round-up savings is supported: Yes. Enable it on your linked debit card to move spare change into savings with each purchase.# Silver Plus Account: Transferring funds to external banks

## Processing timeline
- Standard external transfers typically complete in 2 business days. Initiation day and bank holidays may affect the completion date.

## Transfer limits
- You can transfer out up to $10,000 per day to linked external accounts. If you submit multiple transfers in the same day, their combined total cannot exceed $10,000.

## Fees and statements
- There is no monthly fee for paper statements; the amount is $0.00. If you need paper statements for transfer verification or recordkeeping, you can enable them in settings without affecting transfer processing.

## Best practices
- Initiate transfers in advance of when funds are needed to account for the 2-day processing window.
- If you plan a large payment, verify that it fits within the daily cap of $10,000.# Silver Plus Account: Credit Card APY Bonuses

## Credit card APY bonuses for Silver Plus Account holders

Holding certain Rho-Bank credit cards provides bonus APY on your Silver Plus Account balance. These bonuses are automatically applied when you hold both the credit card and savings account under the same customer profile.

### Available credit card APY bonuses

| Credit Card | APY Bonus |
|---|---|
| Bronze Rewards Card | +0.15% |
| Silver Rewards Card | +0.15% |
| Gold Rewards Card | +0.2% |
| Platinum Rewards Card | +0.15% |
| Diamond Elite Card | +0.4% |
| EcoCard | +0.45% |
| Green Rewards Card | +0.1% |
| Crypto-Cash Back Card | +0% |

### How to qualify

1. Open or maintain a Silver Plus Account.
2. Hold an eligible Rho-Bank credit card under the same customer profile.
3. The APY bonus is automatically applied to your Silver Plus Account earnings.# Silver Account specifications and requirements

## Key specifications

| Specification | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Minimum opening deposit | $500 |
| Ongoing minimum balance | $1,000 |
| Free withdrawals per statement cycle | 10 |
| Interest compounding | daily |
| Balance threshold for higher APY tier | $10,000 |

## Requirements to open and maintain
- Fund at least $500 when you open the account.
- Maintain at least $1,000 each statement cycle to meet account requirements and avoid monthly fees.
- Track your withdrawal activity; transactions beyond 10 in a cycle may incur an excess withdrawal fee as described in your account disclosures.
- To qualify for the higher APY tier, keep your balance at or above $10,000.
- Interest is compounded daily.

## Helpful tips
- Set up balance alerts to help you stay above $1,000 and, if desired, above $10,000.
- If you expect frequent withdrawals, consider spacing them to remain within 10 per cycle.# Linking Silver Account with a Rho checking account

## What linking does
- When you link your Silver Account to a Rho-Bank checking account, your Silver APY receives an additional [[linked_checking_apy_bonus]].
- If you maintain multiple Rho-Bank products, you may also qualify for a relationship bonus of 0.025% that stacks on top of your base Silver APY.

## How to link your accounts
- From your Rho-Bank dashboard, open your Silver Account and choose the option to link a Rho checking account.
- Confirm both accounts are under the same ownership and tax ID.
- Complete the on-screen authorization to finalize the link; APY adjustments typically appear shortly after linking.

## Ongoing eligibility
- Keep both accounts open and in good standing. Unlinking the checking account can remove the [[linked_checking_apy_bonus]] and may affect your eligibility for the 0.025%.# Interest-rate tiers explained

## Tier structure at a glance

| Balance tier | Balance range | APY |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Below threshold | Less than $10,000 | 2.5% |
| At or above threshold | At least $10,000 | 4.0% |

## How your rate is determined
- Each day, your ending balance is compared to $10,000. If it is below that amount, the applicable APY for that day is 2.5%. If it is at or above that amount, the applicable APY for that day is 4.0%.
- Interest accrues on your daily balance and is compounded daily.

## Tips for staying in the higher tier
- Use balance alerts to help keep your balance at or above $10,000.
- Avoid large same-day transfers out that might temporarily move you below $10,000.# Why don't I qualify for Silver Account benefits?

## Common reasons you may not see expected benefits
- Balance below requirement: If your balance falls under $1,000, you may not meet the requirement to avoid the account's monthly maintenance fee and certain perks.
- Not meeting the higher-rate threshold: If your balance is below $10,000, you will not earn the higher APY tier.

## What to check
- Review recent activity for outgoing transfers or withdrawals that brought your balance below $1,000 or $10,000.
- Confirm pending transactions; holds or pending debits can temporarily reduce the balance used to evaluate benefits.

## How to regain eligibility
- Transfer funds to restore your balance to at least $1,000, and if you want the higher APY tier, to at least $10,000.
- Set up balance alerts so you are notified before dropping below these levels.# FAQ: Silver Account

## Frequently asked questions

### What APY does the Silver Account pay?
- Your APY depends on your balance tier. The lower tier pays 2.5%, and the higher tier pays 4.0%.

### What minimum balance should I keep, and what happens if I don't meet it?
- Keep at least $1,000 in your account to meet the minimum balance requirement. If you do not meet this requirement for a statement cycle, a monthly maintenance fee of $5.00 applies.

### Is there a cost if I make too many withdrawals?
- Yes. If you exceed the monthly withdrawal limit for your account, an excess withdrawal fee of $2.00 applies to each additional withdrawal.

### Do I get a bonus for having multiple Rho-Bank products?
- Yes. Eligible customers receive a relationship APY bonus of 0.025% added to the base Silver APY.

### Do you rebate ATM fees?
- Yes. You can receive ATM fee rebates up to 15 each month.# Silver Account: How is interest calculated and when is it paid?

## How interest is calculated
- Your applicable APY depends on your balance tier and may be either 2.5% or 4.0%.
- Interest accrues on your daily balance and is compounded daily. We calculate a daily periodic rate from your APY and apply it to the balance for each day of the cycle.

## When interest is paid
- Accrued interest is credited to your account monthly.

## Credit card APY bonuses
- Holding certain Rho-Bank credit cards provides bonus APY on your Silver Account:
  - Bronze Rewards Card: +0%
  - Silver Rewards Card: +0.1%
  - Gold Rewards Card: +0.5%
  - EcoCard: +2.2%
  - Green Rewards Card: +0%
  - Crypto-Cash Back Card: +0.5%

## Practical notes
- If your balance moves between tiers during a cycle, the applicable APY for each day is based on that day's balance. Interest for the cycle is the sum of each day's accrual.# Silver Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits

## Mobile check deposit limits
- You can deposit up to $2,500 per calendar day using mobile check deposit.
- If you reach the daily limit, you can submit additional deposits on the next calendar day.

## Transfer limits from mobile and online
- Total outgoing transfers from your Silver Account through mobile or online channels are capped at $5,000 per day.
- Transfers that would exceed $5,000 will be declined; you can resubmit the remaining amount on a subsequent day.

## Managing your limits
- Use in-app notifications to monitor how much of your daily limits remain.
- If you consistently need higher limits, contact support to request a review. Approval is not guaranteed and may require additional verification.# Silver Account: Transferring funds to external banks

## Processing times
- Standard transfers to external banks generally complete in 2 business days after submission. Actual timing depends on when you submit the request and receiving-bank processing.

## Amount limits
- Your total outgoing external transfers from the Silver Account are capped at $5,000 per day. Requests above this amount will be partially processed up to the limit or declined, depending on the channel.

## Fees and statements
- There is no monthly fee for paper statements; the amount is $0.00. If you need paper statements for transfer verification or recordkeeping, you can enable them in settings without affecting transfer processing.

## Tips for smooth transfers
- Ensure the external account details are accurate before submitting.
- Submit transfer requests earlier in the business day to reduce the chance of delays.
- Watch for in-app confirmations and email notifications indicating the transfer status.# Silver Account: Platinum Rewards Card holder benefits

## Overview

Silver Account holders who also have a Platinum Rewards Card receive enhanced withdrawal privileges. Your monthly withdrawal limit is increased by 5 additional free withdrawals, bringing your total to 10 + 5 = 15 withdrawals per month. This benefit is automatically applied when both accounts are linked under the same customer profile. Combined with the existing 15 ATM fee rebates and 0.025% relationship bonus, Platinum Rewards Card holders get an elevated Silver Account experience.

## APY bonuses from credit cards
- Platinum Rewards Card: +0.2%
- Diamond Elite Card: +0.25%

## What you receive as a Platinum Rewards Card holder

- Additional free withdrawals: +5 per month on top of your standard 10 free withdrawals
- Total free withdrawals per month: 10 + 5 = 15
- ATM fee relief: Up to 15 in ATM fee rebates each month
- Earnings boost: An additional 0.025% relationship bonus added to your APY when eligible

## Activation and eligibility

- The enhanced withdrawal limit is automatically applied when your Silver Account and Platinum Rewards Card are linked under the same customer profile.
- The 0.025% relationship bonus and 15 ATM fee rebates apply in the same profile-linked setup.

### How to confirm your accounts are linked

1. Sign in to Rho-Bank Online Banking or the mobile app.
2. Open your customer profile and review your list of accounts and cards.
3. Verify that your Silver Account and Platinum Rewards Card appear under the same customer profile.
4. If you do not see both products under one profile, consolidate them to a single profile or contact us for assistance.

## Using your monthly withdrawal allowance

- Counting method: Any transaction classified as a withdrawal under your Silver Account terms counts toward your monthly total of 15 free withdrawals.
- Cycle timing: Your free withdrawal count resets at the start of each monthly statement cycle.
- Beyond the limit: Transactions above your free monthly total may be subject to standard Silver Account withdrawal charges.

Example:
- You make 12 withdrawals in a month: all 12 are free.
- You make 15 withdrawals in a month: all 15 are free.
- You make 16 withdrawals in a month: the first 15 are free; the 16th may incur standard charges.

## ATM fee rebates

- You are eligible for up to 15 in ATM fee rebates each month.
- Rebates apply after ATM fees post to your Silver Account; check your transaction history for the corresponding credit within the same month.

## Relationship bonus APY

- When your Silver Account and Platinum Rewards Card are linked under the same customer profile, an additional 0.025% is added to your APY as a relationship bonus.
- The relationship bonus is reflected in your APY while eligibility is maintained.

## Troubleshooting and tips

- If you do not see the extra withdrawals or 0.025% reflected, confirm both products are under the same customer profile.
- Check that you are within the current monthly statement cycle for the added withdrawals to apply.
- Review your transaction history to verify ATM fee charges and corresponding rebates up to 15 for the month.

simulations.policy:
# Rho-Bank Customer Service Policy

You are a helpful customer service agent for Rho-Bank.
Your goal is to help customers by searching the knowledge base and providing accurate information.

## Guidelines

1. Do not make up policies, information or actions that you can take on behalf of the user. All instructions will be found here or in the knowledge base. If you cannot find relevant information, let the user know. 
2. Do not ask for any documentation, receipts... from the customer unless it states very clearly in the knowledge base how to process it, and whether you're allowed to do so. 
3. Be polite and professional
4. If you need the current time, always use the get_current_time() tool. Do not make up or assume the current time. 
5. Generally, if the issue cannot be resolved or is outside your capabilities, ask the user whether they would like to be transferred to a human agent. If they do, invoke the appropriate transfer_to_human_agents tool. Do this only if you absolutely have to, and you are sure that there are no potential actions you can take as specified in the knowledge base, or in your policy. Do not transfer without asking the user first. This guidance may be overridden by specific scenario-based transfer guidance in the knowledge base. 
6. If an issue falls within your capabilities and the user still wants to be transferred to a human agent, kindly inform the user that you can help them, and try to help them first. If the user asks for a human agent 4 times, then you may invoke the transfer_to_human_agents tool. This guidance may be overridden by specific scenario-based transfer guidance in the knowledge base. 
7. Do not give intermediate responses to users while processing that would give away internal rho-bank information/policies. 


## Knowledge base search tools

You have three complementary ways to access the knowledge base:

### `KB_search_bm25`

**Search the knowledge base** using **BM25** sparse retrieval. Pass **`k`** (default 10) to control how many documents to retrieve.

### `KB_search_dense`

The `KB_search_dense` tool uses **local** with embedding model `sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2` for dense retrieval.

Pass **`k`** (default 10) to control how many documents to retrieve.

### `shell`

## Knowledge Base Access (shell)

You have access to a knowledge base of documents stored as files on a filesystem. Use the `shell` tool to run standard Unix commands to explore and search these documents.

### The `shell` Tool

The `shell` tool executes commands in the knowledge base directory. Use any standard Unix utilities:

**File listing:**
- `ls` - List all files
- `ls -la` - Detailed listing with file sizes

**Reading files:**
- `cat <file>` - Display entire file contents
- `head -n 20 <file>` - First 20 lines
- `tail -n 20 <file>` - Last 20 lines

**Searching:**
- `grep -r "<pattern>" .` - Search all files for pattern
- `grep -ri "<pattern>" .` - Case-insensitive search
- `grep -rn "<pattern>" .` - Show line numbers
- `grep -C 2 "<pattern>" <file>` - Show 2 lines of context

**Finding files:**
- `find . -name "*<pattern>*"` - Find files by name pattern

**Other utilities:**
- `wc -l <file>` - Count lines
- `sort`, `uniq`, `awk`, `sed` - Text processing

### Recommended Workflow

1. `ls` - See what files are available
2. `cat INDEX.md` - Read the document index (lists all documents with titles)
3. `grep -ri "<keyword>" .` - Search for relevant keywords
4. `cat <filename>` - Read full documents that match

### Important Notes

- All documents are Markdown (.md) files in the current directory
- INDEX.md contains a summary of all documents
- File names are based on document IDs
- Search thoroughly - information may span multiple documents



## Additional Instructions

### Discoverable Tools

#### Giving Discoverable Tools to Users
The knowledge base may contain instructions that indicate certain actions should be performed by the user themselves rather than by you. These are called "user discoverable tools." A user discoverable tool is a tool that you provide to the user so they can execute it on their own (e.g., through a customer portal or app).

**When to give user discoverable tools:**
-  Only give a tool when the user would like to perform an action, and the knowledge base explicitly has a tool that allows the user to perform this action (e.g., "to do X, have the user call tool_name(args)"). IMPORTANT: Do not unlock tools that you do not plan on giving to the user and actually using: this causes issues in database logging.
- You must search the knowledge base to find tools that you can give. Do not invent or guess user discoverable tools 
- Only use tool names and arguments discovered in the knowledge base

**How to give a tool:**
- Use the `give_discoverable_user_tool(discoverable_tool_name)` function
- Provide the exact tool name  as specified in the knowledge base
- Explain to the user what the tool does and how to use it, and what arguments to provide. Just explaining isn't enough, you must use the `give_discoverable_user_tool(discoverable_tool_name)` function.

#### Unlocking and Using Agent Discoverable Tools
The knowledge base may contain references to specialized internal tools that you can unlock and use. These are called "agent discoverable tools." Unlike regular tools which are always available, these tools must be explicitly unlocked after discovering them in the knowledge base.

**When to use agent discoverable tools:**
- Only unlock a tool when the knowledge base explicitly mentions it (e.g., "use tool_name to perform X"), and do not unlock tools you do not plan to use.
- You must search the knowledge base to find tools that you can unlock. Do not invent or guess tool names - only use tool names discovered in the knowledge base.

**How to use agent discoverable tools:**
1. First, unlock the tool using `unlock_discoverable_agent_tool(agent_tool_name)` with the exact tool name from the knowledge base: you must unlock the tool before using it to get information on the proper params. IMPORTANT: Do not unlock tools that you do not plan on actually using: this causes issues in database logging.
2. Then, call the tool using `call_discoverable_agent_tool(agent_tool_name, arguments)` with the required arguments
3. The unlock step is required before calling - you cannot call a tool that hasn't been unlocked

### Authenticating Users

Generally, for any scenario involving accessing customer information in internal databases, you must first verify their identify before proceeding. No need to verify more than once in a single conversation. You should ONLY verify a user's identity if you need to access or modify their customer information in internal databases on their behalf.

Here are some concrete examples:
* Looking up account balances, transaction history, referral history...
* Changing account settings (e.g., address, phone number, email)
* Closing an account
* Adding or removing authorized users
* Requesting information about specific transactions
* Discussing specific loan or credit details
* Filing a dispute on behalf of the user

To verify the identity of the user, call the appropriate read tools, and ensure that they are able to give correctly any 2 out of the following values: date of birth, email, phone number, address. Knowing full name or userID is not enough to verify. After verification, you must call the verification logging tool to properly log the information into the verification records. Do not leak any information about the user before they are verified.

message.content: Wait, why can't we just do the closures first? That seems like the logical order to me, clean up before adding new stuff.

messages.content:
Cleaning up first makes sense, but it would block two of your requests.

- **Business checking:** A business checking account can't be opened if any of your accounts has a CLOSED status. Once the Bronze savings or Evergreen checking account is closed, that rule would stop the new account from opening.
- **Savings account:** A new personal savings account needs a checking account that has been open at least 14 days. Your Evergreen checking account is the only one that qualifies, because your Light Blue account was opened too recently. If we closed Evergreen first, you'd have no qualifying checking account, and I couldn't open the savings account.

If we open the new accounts first, all four requests can go through. After that, we can close Evergreen and Bronze and move their balances wherever you want them.

Are you comfortable with that order? If so, I'll need answers to the business checking questions from my last message so I can recommend the right account for your LLC.
